Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 25-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee JRF/SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Roorkee JRF/SRF positions is 25 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the JRF/SRF post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the JRF/SRF post in the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply for this recruitment by sending their complete application via email.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF/SRF positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 37,000/- per month + HRA for JRF and Rs. 42,000/- per month + HRA for SRF.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the JRF/SRF post?
faq.answer: The required qualifications include M.Sc/M.Sc.Tech/M.Tech degrees in various science and engineering disciplines, with specific requirements for NET/GATE for certain specializations.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF/SRF positions at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 247667.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this IIT Roorkee JRF/SRF recruitment is ISR-2733-DMC/25-26/JRF/INT/A.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for contractual positions at the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee.
